title: +92% upside: $COHU $38.49 to $74, can it get back to the analyst target?
author: tickeron_community
selftext:
Cohu's $74 target is the average of eight analyst targets, ranging from $53 to $90, and every recent rating is a Buy. From the $38.49 close, getting there would take about a 92% gain. The bull case is AI and HPC demand: Q3 revenue rose 37%, bookings jumped 126%, and the company is profitable again. Its Eclipse handlers and Neon HBM inspection tools sit in AI chip testing. The main risks are extreme volatility (the stock is down about 48% from its October peak despite the beat), automotive weakness and customer concentration. This is a target, not a promise.

Full analysis: https://tickeron.com/blogs/cohu-cohu-can-the-stock-reclaim-the-74-analyst-target-after-recent-volatility-33220/
